title: Planted q-ary Coset-Shift Fourier-Bias Bridge: QFT Phase Erasure, Off-Dual Shift Invariance, and Exact First-Moment Equalization on Affine Cosets B + a

theorems.name: Exact QFT Dual-Subspace Support Conservation and Shift-Phase Erasure
theorems.statement: For any dimension-d subspace B in F_q^n and shift a in F_q^n, QFT_q^(tensor n) |psi_(B+a)> = q^(-(n-d)/2) sum_(u in B^perp) omega_q^(<a, u>) |u>, so computational-basis measurement after QFT_q^(tensor n) yields the uniform distribution on B^perp identically for all shifts a in F_q^n.

theorems.name: Deterministic Off-Dual Shift Invariance and Dual-Subspace Collapse
theorems.statement: For every probe u not in B^perp and every window W in F_q of size R, N_W(u; B + a) = q^(d-1) R = N_W(u; B) for all shifts a in F_q^n. For u in B^perp, N_W(u; B + a) = q^d * 1_(<a, u> in W).

theorems.name: Exact First-Moment Equalization on Non-Trivial Cosets a not in B
theorems.statement: Averaging over uniform u in F_q^n yields E_u[N_W(u; B + a)] = 1_(0 in W) + (q^d - 1)(R/q) when a in B, whereas for every non-trivial coset shift a in F_q^n \ B, E_u[N_W(u; B + a)] = q^(d-1) R regardless of whether 0 in W.
